context: Add value-level URI userinfo handling at the shared platform option sanitizer after exact-key classification, then drive database_path, endpoint, nested, list, and tuple values through internal and public result metadata boundaries.
description: The structural option sanitizer classifies values by key. A driven SQLite adapter carried a credential-bearing PostgreSQL URI in its non-secret database_path key, and sanitize_platform_options preserved URI_PASSWORD through extracted platform.config and public metadata. Scrub embedded credential userinfo in string option values while preserving ordinary non-credential URLs, paths, and tuning values.

preserves.behavior: non-secret filesystem paths and tuning values

verifications.command: PYTHONPATH=. uv run --all-extras -- python -c 'import json; from benchbox.core.results.platform_options import sanitize_platform_options; out=sanitize_platform_options({"database_path":"postgresql://user:URI_PASSWORD@db.example/db","output_location":"https://user:URI_TOKEN@example.com/export","threads":4}); text=json.dumps(out); assert "URI_PASSWORD" not in text and "URI_TOKEN" not in text'
verifications.description: credential material embedded in a non-secret option value is absent after sanitization
verifications.expected: expected: exits 1 on an unfixed tree because URI userinfo survives; exits 0 after value-level URI scrubbing

verifications.command: PYTHONPATH=. uv run --all-extras -- python -c 'from benchbox.core.results.platform_options import sanitize_platform_options; out=sanitize_platform_options({"url":"https://public.example/export","path":"/tmp/data","sort_key":"o_orderkey"}); assert out=={"url":"https://public.example/export","path":"/tmp/data","sort_key":"o_orderkey"}'
verifications.description: ordinary URL and option-value behavior remains green
verifications.expected: expected: passes before and after as a regression guard
expected: passes before and after as a regression guard
